notes:
Product / requirements notes:
- Primary goal: replace manual QA summarization + speed up coaching loop. Need per-call: compact summary (3 bullets), excerpted coaching clips (~10-20s), QA score (0-100) + root cause tags.
- Voice specifics: speaker diarization required, per-utterance confidence, exact timestamps for coaching clips. Must support multi-leg transfers and conference legs.
- Tool-calling: On summary publish, auto-create/update Zendesk ticket + push coaching task to LMS via webhook. Also need optional CRM field patch (Salesforce case fields).
- Latency / reliability: Target median end-to-end summary latency <= 3s after call close for 90% of calls; streaming partial summary desirable for supervisors. Scale: expected peak concurrency 1.2k live calls regionally, 6k calls/hour burst — need autoscale/fallback policy.
- Cost sensitivity: want platform suggestions (batch config + cache) to reduce token spend for repetitive system prompts and greetings. Potential to use quantized model variants for nightly batch QA scoring.
- Security/compliance: Mandatory SOC2 + SSO/SAML; retention controls: 90-day raw audio retention default; long-term storage on customer-managed bucket (EU). KMS integrated per-customer.
- Evaluation criteria (customer): summary accuracy vs human baseline (F1 on highlights), QA score correlation with internal raters (>0.85), latencies under load, reliable tool-calls (idempotency), clean audit trail for edits.
- Quote from head of QA: "If summaries take >5s agents stop trusting the tool — that's the single biggest adoption risk."
- Current integrations: Zendesk proof-of-concept connector exists; Telos wants Redwood to host inference but route sensitive EU calls to private endpoint.
- POC plan: 2-week functional run ingesting 50k recent calls (anonymized), then 48h spike test (simulate 2x expected burst). Success = >90% pass on latency SLA and QA correlation >0.8.
- Risks/unknowns: how Redwood handles prefix caching for agent scripts, tokenization differences vs internal NLP stack, retention of ephemeral KV cache used for multi-turn summarization.
